profile.name: Jack-8
profile.overview: Jack-8 is arguably Tekken's most potent character in the midrange. Through strong pokes, incredible range on lows and launchers, and great whiff punish options, Jack allows you to dominate the neutral game and force your opponent to take risks to come to you.
profile.playstyle: Mid-range monster. Stop the opponent's approach with safe neutral tools (b+2, df+1, b+3), use the huge range of his lows and launchers, and build Gamma Charge for armoured, guard-breaking hits. Wavu warns he has no i10 jab and a huge, slow body, so he struggles when pressured up close.
strengths: Neutral Stop Signs: b+2, df+1, and b+3 are all extremely effective and safe ways to stop opponents from approaching in neutral. Jack also has riskier options like df+2, db+2, and f+2 that lead to huge damage if they land.
Excellent Pressure: Jack has good ways to access scary plus frames, and many of Jack's pressure moves can transition into Gamma Howl for either stopping mashes or forcing a mixup.
Easy Bake Mixups: Gamma Howl gives Jack several highly rewarding mixup options. Outside of Gamma Howl, Jack has a complete throw game and several devastating power mids to play around with.
Absurd Damage: Jack's combos and power mids hits like a truck
Heat Smash: Jack has the fastest Heat Smash in the game at i10, making it a very powerful block/whiff punisher. It also has good range and chip on block.
weaknesses: Huge and Slow: Jack lacks an i10 jab from both standing and crouch, making it difficult to press when he's being pressured. He also has a bad sidestep which makes it hard for him to evade attacks at close ranges. Proper use of his new Gamma Howl armor can help with this issue.
Mediocre Lows: Jack's low pokes give middling reward, and his bigger lows are slow and/or launch punishable.

stances.name: Gamma Howl
stances.entry: 3+4, or D after f,F+1 and ss2
stances.note: GMH.4 and GMH.3+4 are Heat Engagers; GMH.2 is +11g on block.

stances.name: Gamma Charge
stances.entry: 3+4 while absorbing a hit, or landing hold moves on hit or block
stances.note: Charged versions: GMC.2 guard-breaks and is +11 on block. In Heat, Gamma Charge moves are always active (Wavu).

heat: Gamma Charge moves are always active.
